Explain the example for create a browser counter

blocks.text: A Client Component can use browser state and click handlers. The use client line marks that boundary.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Create a browser counter

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `use client` marks a Next.js component boundary for browser interaction. It must appear before imports in that file.
`useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.

blocks.text: When imported and rendered by a page, the counter updates after clicks in the browser.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The marker is a quoted string before imports. A Client Component is not a safe place for secret keys.
